record.title: Charlevoix Common Vision for the Future of Artificial Intelligence
record.short_title: G7 Charlevoix Common Vision on AI (2018)
record.summary: Commitment by the G7 leaders at their 2018 Charlevoix summit to promote human-centric AI and its commercial adoption. They commit to safeguard privacy, invest in cybersecurity, promote industry research on safety, assurance, data quality and data security, encourage AI that addresses accountability, assurance, liability, security, safety, bias and potential misuse, foster initiatives that promote safety and transparency and give guidance on human intervention in AI decision-making, and improve digital security in AI through voluntary codes of conduct, standards or guidelines, alongside commitments on skills, gender equality and adoption by small firms.
record.notes: One of eight declarations the G7 leaders issued on 9 June 2018 at the 44th G7 summit in La Malbaie (Charlevoix), Quebec. It refers to the 2018 G7 Montreal Ministerial Statement on Artificial Intelligence and to the multi-stakeholder, human-centric vision of the 2017 G7 ICT and Industry Ministers' Torino Declaration. Its other commitments cover lifelong learning and reskilling, the participation of women and underrepresented groups, multistakeholder dialogue, support for unpaid caregivers, and an open and fair market environment including the free flow of information. Global Affairs Canada published it in English and in French (Vision commune de Charlevoix sur l'avenir de l'intelligence artificielle).

verification.note: Stored Global Affairs Canada's page with the full English text and its PDF version, the French page and PDF, and the Government of Canada Publications catalogue record (all on gc.ca, official). The text confirms the title and the commitments by 'the Leaders of the G7'; the catalogue record confirms the issue on 9 June 2018 at the Charlevoix summit (44th G7 summit, La Malbaie), the publisher and the French edition. The candidate's publications.gc.ca PDF link now leads to an archived-content notice with no text. A copy on mofa.go.jp refused a plain request and was not stored.

judgment.status_reasoning: Issued by the G7 leaders on 9 June 2018 as a statement of commitment; no stored source withdraws or replaces it. A leaders' declaration remains a published statement, so Published (non-binding, current), as for the register's later G7 leaders' statements (G7-05).
judgment.date_reasoning: The text itself carries no date; date_published is the issue date in the official catalogue record, 9 June 2018, which also matches the date in the page's URL.
judgment.identifier_reasoning: The declaration has no document number; the catalogue number FR5-144/2018-27E-PDF is a library catalogue number of the Canadian edition, so official_identifier is null.
judgment.legal_force_reasoning: A political commitment of the G7 leaders: Non-binding.

judgment.scope_reasoning: An intergovernmental declaration on AI with safety, security, accountability and human-intervention commitments; in with no note under AGENTS.md section 10.
